title: Question 1.1: Schema Definition
instruction: Before we can work with data in a program, we need to tell the computer what structure to expect. This code defines the "shape" of the data file.
reveal: This code creates a schema (a blueprint) that describes the structure of the CSV file. It tells Java that the file has two columns: "text" (which contains strings) and "sentiment" (which also contains strings). The `false` parameter means these columns cannot be empty. This is similar to defining the columns in a spreadsheet before you start entering data.
